steps.title: Install ImageMagick 7
steps.detail: Unify installs it for you; Windows may ask for permission once. If that failed, run the Windows x64 installer from the download page, keep "Add application directory to your system path" ticked, then choose Run setup again below.

steps.title: Install oxipng
steps.detail: Makes PNGs smaller without losing quality. Unify installs it for you.

steps.title: Install pngquant
steps.detail: Makes PNGs much smaller by reducing colours. The install script downloads it into ${PACK}/data/bin/pngquant. If that failed, check your internet connection and choose Run setup again below.

steps.title: Install pngquant
steps.detail: Makes PNGs much smaller by reducing colours. Unify installs it with Homebrew.

steps.title: Add pngquant (optional)
steps.detail: Makes PNGs much smaller by reducing colours. Install it with your package manager (command below), then choose Run setup again.

steps.title: Install Real-ESRGAN for upscaling
steps.detail: The install script downloads it (about 45 MB) into ${PACK}/data/bin/realesrgan. It runs on your graphics card. If the download failed, check your internet connection and choose Run setup again below.

steps.title: Add background removal (optional)
steps.detail: Lets agents cut a subject out onto a transparent background. Needs Python 3.10 or newer (get it from python.org and tick "Add python.exe to PATH"). Choose Install; the first cut-out also downloads a model of about 170 MB.
